files.description: Working guide for AI agents: architecture, testing rules, code style and the comment policy this repo enforces. Read it before judging a comment, a test or a tool change — it is the source of truth these reviews are graded against.
Submission quality bar and code standards, identical for human and AI authors.
Tool-definition quality criteria (Glama TDQS) and the rules on changing the published JSON Schema: never drop a field, loosen a type, or lose what a description said.
Why the retry loop is ours rather than a library's, and the policy table a new client method must pick a row in.
Why the mutation gate exists and what a surviving mutant means: an assertion is missing or too loose, never a reason to weaken one.
